title: Custom Fields
subtitle: Manage custom fields and system variables for your contacts.
emptyCustom: No custom fields. New fields also appear when a contact gets a new key.

errors.length: The key must be 2 to 255 characters long.
errors.chars: The key may only contain letters, numbers, space, "_" and "-".
errors.reserved: Key reserved for a system field.

fields.keyHint: Lowercase; letters, numbers, space, "_" and "-". In messages, use the key between braces.

systemNote: This field value is computed by the system and cannot be edited. Only the description changes.
